mapper.select: SELECT s.store_id AS storeId, s.material_id AS materialId, m.material_name AS materialName, IFNULL(SUM(l.change_qty), 0) AS loggedQty, IFNULL(s.stock_qty, 0) AS stockQty FROM inv_store_material_stock s LEFT JOIN inv_stock_log l ON l.store_id = s.store_id AND l.material_id = s.material_id JOIN bom_material m ON m.id = s.material_id GROUP BY s.store_id, s.material_id, m.material_name, s.stock_qty HAVING IFNULL(SUM(l.change_qty), 0) <> IFNULL(s.stock_qty, 0) ORDER BY s.store_id, m.material_name
